description.value:
Requirement You are wielding a loaded firearm.

Duration 1 minute, or until you Stride

Declare a line of your own space and the two adjacent to it. While it holds, you may make a ranged Strike as a reaction against any enemy that enters or crosses that line, once per enemy per round, without expending your normal reaction. Each such Strike empties one loaded weapon; when you have nothing loaded, the line ends.
